questions.question: MSA and SPC deference
questions.answer: MSA evaluates measurement system accuracy; SPC monitors process stability and control over time.MSA (Measurement System Analysis) assesses the accuracy, precision, and reliability of measurement instruments and methods.SPC (Statistical Process Control) uses statistical methods to monitor and control a process to ensure it operates at its full potential.MSA focuses on reducing measurement errors like repeatability and reproducibility; for example, checking gauge consistency.SPC involves control charts (e.g., X-bar, R charts) to detect process variations and maintain quality standards.MSA is typically performed before or during process setup to validate measurement tools.SPC is an ongoing activity during production to detect trends, shifts, or any unusual variation in the process.
